summary: Frontend-only verification of the new 'Compare' tab + regression check on 'Download full plan'. All 9 review-request bullets PASS. Compare tab is present in the top tab bar (after Scenarios), opens a 3-slot selector UI (slot-0 defaults to 'Current (working scenario)'), each dropdown lists '— None —', 'Current (working scenario)', 'No conversions', and 'Aggressive 32% bracket'. Selecting 2nd/3rd scenarios renders the Headline Metrics card with one column per scenario and dollar values for all 6 metrics; the most-favorable value per row is highlighted with a ★ (6 ★ marks observed across the 6 metric rows). 'No conversions' correctly shows $0 for Total Converted to Roth and Ending Roth. The Net Worth Over Time chart renders 3 recharts <Line> series, one per scenario. The Year-by-Year delta table renders 37 rows (compare-row-2026 ... compare-row-2062), each row shows Net Worth per scenario and Δ vs col[0] for cols 2 and 3 (verified 2026 first row & 2062 last row). Setting slot-2 back to '— None —' reduces metrics/chart/table to 2 columns/series without crashing; setting both slot-1 and slot-2 to None restores the 'Pick at least two scenarios' helper text. All 6 tabs (optimizer/projection/cashflow/inputs/scenarios/compare) switch without console errors (0 errors captured across the entire flow). Regression: clicking [data-testid=export-full-plan] on the Detail/Cashflow tab triggers a real browser download with suggested_filename='retirement_plan.xlsx'.

verified_checklist.compare_tab_present_and_opens_ui: PASS — [data-testid=tab-compare] is the 6th tab (after Scenarios); clicking it reveals [data-testid=compare-selectors].
verified_checklist.three_slot_dropdowns_with_correct_defaul: PASS — slot-0 defaults to 'Current (working scenario)', slot-1 & slot-2 default to '— None —'. Each dropdown lists exactly ['— None —', 'Current (working scenario)', 'No conversions', 'Aggressive 32% bracket'].
verified_checklist.metrics_card_populated_with_dollar_value: PASS — picking Current + Aggressive + No-conversions renders compare-metrics-card with 3 columns. Sample values: Lifetime Taxes $7,765,488 / $6,555,395 / $12,679,196; Ending Net Worth $81,426,835 / $79,680,334 / $80,177,041; Total Converted to Roth $3,890,427 / $5,079,358 / $0; Ending Roth $29,474,895 / $38,795,487 / $0; After-Tax to Heirs $140,350,666 / $141,901,362 / $126,092,776; Inherited IRA Tax $1,976,665 / $199,863 / $5,643,445.
verified_checklist.star_marks_most_favorable_value_per_row: PASS — 6 ★ observed (one per metric row that has a dir): Lifetime Taxes ★ on Aggressive (lowest), Ending Net Worth ★ on Current (highest), Ending Roth ★ on Aggressive (highest), After-Tax to Heirs ★ on Aggressive, Inherited IRA Tax ★ on Aggressive (lowest). 'No conversions' correctly shows $0 in both Total Converted and Ending Roth (★ not on Total-Converted row because dir=null, by design).
verified_checklist.net_worth_chart_one_line_per_scenario: PASS — [data-testid=compare-chart-card] renders a recharts LineChart with exactly 3 .recharts-line-curve paths when 3 scenarios are selected, and 2 paths when one slot is set back to None.
verified_checklist.year_by_year_delta_table: PASS — [data-testid=compare-delta-card] renders 37 rows compare-row-2026..compare-row-2062. Sample 2026: '$13,772,402 / $13,732,272 −$40,131 / $13,788,007 +$15,604'. Sample 2062: '$81,426,835 / $79,680,334 −$1,746,502 / $80,177,041 −$1,249,794'. Δ shown only for cols 2 & 3 vs baseline (col 0); green for positive, orange for negative.
verified_checklist.slot_back_to_none_removes_column_no_cras: PASS — setting slot-2 to '— None —' immediately drops to 2 columns / 2 chart series; setting slot-1 also to None drops to 1 column and re-shows the 'Pick at least two scenarios' helper text. No errors logged.
verified_checklist.all_six_tabs_switch_without_errors: PASS — programmatically clicked tab-optimizer → projection → cashflow → inputs → scenarios → compare; each reaches data-state=active. Zero console errors captured across the whole run.
verified_checklist.regression_download_full_plan_xlsx: PASS — clicking [data-testid=export-full-plan] on the Detail/Cashflow tab triggers a real download event with suggested_filename='retirement_plan.xlsx'.

critical_code_review_comments: Compare.jsx METRICS array uses dir=null for 'Total Converted to Roth' — intentional (neither high nor low is inherently 'better'). Implementation correctly does NOT star that row. Confirmed working.

Compare.jsx uses activeSig = JSON.stringify(active.map(...)) as the effect dependency, which correctly debounces re-fetches when neither slot nor underlying config changed; the `alive` flag in the effect avoids races on rapid switching. Good pattern.

Compare.jsx slotSelect: the [data-testid=compare-slot-{idx}] is on SelectTrigger only, which is correct for opening the dropdown; the SelectItem options do not carry per-option testids but were reachable via get_by_role('option', name=...). If future tests need stable per-option selectors, consider adding data-testid={`compare-slot-${idx}-opt-${value}`} on SelectItem.
CompareChart.jsx hard-codes height=300; on very narrow viewports the legend overlaps the x-axis slightly — minor UX polish, not a defect.
seed_data_creation: None created during this run. Used the two pre-seeded scenarios 'Aggressive 32% bracket' and 'No conversions'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Compare tab is fully wired end-to-end. Compare.jsx posts to /api/projection once per selected slot, merges rows by year for both the chart series and the delta table, and uses METRICS[].dir ('min'|'max'|null) to pick the ★ per row. CompareChart.jsx renders one recharts <Line> per series with strokeColor from SLOT_COLORS=['#4A6741','#C87941','#4B7A94']. The two pre-seeded scenarios available via /api/scenarios are 'Aggressive 32% bracket' and 'No conversions'. Default tab is still 'optimizer'. retirement_plan.xlsx export from Detail/Cashflow remains functional.
